relationships.subject: alpha-CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Loss of the sensory neuropeptide α-CGRP strongly impacts on bone homeostasis, demonstrated by the development of an osteopenic bone phenotype in six-month-old α-CGRP-deficient mice [22].

key_findings: In OVX mice, loss of alpha-CGRP or SP altered fracture callus and trabecular bone and changed fMRI functional connectivity; alpha-CGRP deficiency had no direct impact on baseline nociception.
